disposition: APPROVE exact three-source proposal as inert, subject to separate current-parent R1/R2 and original resulting-source CI; no actual ARM acceptance or historical-cause claim
sourceFindings: The executing PowerShell process returns its own $PID in the same command envelope as the original process census. No second process query is introduced. The returned ID must resolve to exactly one row in that census; missing, duplicate, nonpositive/noninteger IDs, invalid self parent and noncanonical birth refuse.

The original driver is retained at Gate startup under the existing executable/controller checks. Each later observer check requires current driver PID/birth equality, the same original driver parent and observer.parent equal to driver.pid. It rejects observer PID equal to the driver or its parent.

All current census PID entries must be unique. The self row must equal the supplied closed three-field observer. Candidate children must be directly parented to this current observer and have safe positive PID and canonical seven-fraction UTC birth strictly later than observer birth.

The generic packagedOrphanObservation implementation is unchanged and still produces ambiguous-parent-identity for the reproduced reused-parent case. Gate filters only candidates that simultaneously join the same current parent PID/birth and the validated current-query direct child PID/parent/birth.

Every remaining unexplained candidate refuses under the original assertion. No executable/name exemption, retained historical query authority, fallback query or broad timestamp-only removal is introduced.

The query observer is explicitly forbidden from current App lineage. Query children and explanation records never enter App lineage, retained cleanup ownership or signal authority. The original full census remains the returned value.

The original listener ownership assertion is unchanged and still requires every listener PID/current birth to join original App lineage. Explaining a query child does not make it an eligible CDP listener.
The original read observer wrapper, all deadline/action/cleanup code from readJson onward, generic process/listener functions and downstream platform helpers remain byte-identical.

Legacy two-argument combined reads retain their original script, envelope keys and result fields by literal concatenation with captureObserver=false. Explicit observer mode requires a boolean before invoking the executor. The Windows Gate is the opted-in consumer.
No wall-clock or performance.now call, external observation, RPC, retry, wait, action, timeout, signal operation or process-creation callsite is added.
